briefdescription.para: Sends the specified buffer of data using the UART.

detaileddescription.para: This function operates in either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns before the data has been sent by the UART. If the UART is busy sending data, it returns and indicates zero bytes were sent.
In a polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the UART can buffer in the FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send a buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues sending data until the buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending the buffer.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer of data to send.
Number of bytes to send. A value of zero stops a previous send operation that is in progress in interrupt mode. Any data that was already put into the transmit FIFO is sent.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.
The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Receives a specified number of bytes of data from the UART.

detaileddescription.para: This function attempts to receive the data and store it into the specified buffer. It is designed for either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns if no data has already been received by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only receives as much data as the UART can buffer in the FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive a buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts receiving and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues receiving data until the buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of receiving the buffer or when any receive errors or timeouts occur.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to buffer to receive data into.
Number of bytes to receive. A value of zero stops a previous receive operation that is in progress in interrupt mode.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes received.
The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Resets the FIFOs, both transmit and receive, of the UART.

detaileddescription.para: The FIFOs are emptied. Since the UART does not have any way to disable it from receiving data, it may be necessary for the application to reset the FIFOs to get rid of any unwanted data.

briefdescription.para: Determines if the specified UART is sending data.

detaileddescription.para: If the transmitter register is not empty, it is sending data.

simplesect.para: A value of TRUE if the UART is sending data, otherwise FALSE.

briefdescription.para: Sends a previously specified buffer of data to the UART.

detaileddescription.para: The buffer is specified beforehand by setting up the instance variables of the instance. This function is designed to be an internal function for the XUartLite component such that it may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.
It sends the specified buffer of data to the UART in either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns before the data has been sent by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the transmitter or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send a buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues until the buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending the buffer.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent (put into the UART transmitter and/or FIFO).

briefdescription.para: Receives a previously specified buffer of data from the UART.

detaileddescription.para: The buffer is specified beforehand by setting up the instance variables of the instance. This function is designed to be an internal function for the XUartLite component such that it may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.

It attempts to receive a specified number of bytes of data from the UART and store it into the specified buffer. It is designed for either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking such that it returns if there is no data already received by the UART.

In a polled mode, this function only receives as much data as the UART can buffer, either in the receiver or in the FIFO if present and enabled. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive a buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts receiving and then the interrupt handler of the driver continues until the buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of receiving the buffer or when any receive errors or timeouts occur.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes received.

briefdescription.para: Reads the status register and updates the error stats before returning the status register value.

detaileddescription.para: The status register is a clear on read register, so the errors if occurred have to be recorded every time the status register is read. This function is designed to be an internal function for the XUartLite component such that it may be called from wherever the status register needs to be read from the other driver functions.

simplesect.para: The value of status register.

detaileddescription.para: The receive and transmit FIFOs of the UART are not flushed, so they may be flushed if desired. The hardware device does not have any way to disable the receiver such that any valid data may be present in the receive FIFO. This function disables the UART interrupt. The baudrate and format of the data are fixed in the hardware at hardware build time.

detaileddescription.para: Since there is no way to perform a loopback in the hardware, this test can only check the state of the status register to verify it is correct. This test assumes that the hardware device is still in its reset state, but has been initialized with the Initialize function.

detaileddescription.para: An interrupt occurs when data is received or data has been transmitted. The device contains 16 byte receive and transmit FIFOs such that an interrupt is generated anytime there is data in the receive FIFO and when the transmit FIFO transitions from not empty to empty.
After calling this function, data may still be received by the UART but no interrupt is generated since the hardware device has no way to disable the receiver.
